§6Centrifuge§f spins a single fluid input at high RPM to separate dissolved or suspended components. It handles isotope enrichment (uranium hexafluoride into U-235/U-238), water desalinization, lava processing, and ore processing.

The multiblock is 3x3x3 with casing blocks and Structure Blocks. It needs a Steel Fan for tier 1 recipes, but tier 3 isotope separation requires a Titanium Fan to handle the higher RPM. Power is 30 RF/t baseline.

This machine works hand-in-hand with the Chemical Reactor and Electrolyser to form a fluid-processing pipeline that feeds satellites and atmospheric processors.

§ePS:§f Watch the GUI progress bar, recipes scale with input amount. A single Steel Fan covers most early recipes.
